scope: Consortia historical changes and current projection; widget-ready backend
remote_publication: Compiled, saved and published source reread; normalized source matches all submitted functions
permissions: Existing authenticated gateway requires Administrator in User Relationships for this operation. Olga-specific authorization remains pending.

schedule.name: Client Consortia Sync
schedule.scope: At most 25 history rows per sweep with a persistent ID cursor. Repeated clients are deduplicated within a batch. Failed batches retain their original cursor.
schedule.effective_date_timing: Dates use Europe/Madrid. Projection changes occur on sweep, not necessarily exactly at midnight. End-to-end lag also depends on full-circuit size.

arguments.requestBody: JSON containing operation=client_consortia_manage and requestBody=JSON request

transport.public_helpers: None; internal functions retain REST None
reconcile_requires: Version at least two seconds old
A final pending checkpoint; started/recovering operations are never reclaimed solely by elapsed time
operator_review_required: Historical create outcome cannot be proven
History differs from the recorded operation

rules: No duplicate/overlapping membership for the same client and consortia
Unknown starts require explicit acknowledgment and Observed_On, never an invented start
Current projection only from confirmed periods; uncertain history blocks destructive projection
Future starts use Scheduled; elapsed starts/end dates update statuses during synchronization
No history rows are deleted; only obsolete current projection links may be removed
Exact request replay returns the recorded result without a new historical write
Projection reconciliation does not replay the historical mutation
Partial history saves return history_saved=true when confirmed
pending: Controlled live widget preview/apply/cancel and persisted checkpoint verification
Controlled concurrent-session, partial response and recovery acceptance
Connection scope and linking-record CRUD runtime acceptance
Calendar sweep full-circuit timing and capacity validation before enabling schedule
Olga widget UI and final user authorization
Existing direct CRM edits outside these functions do not participate in the engine lock; permissions and UI policy remain to be finalized
source_policy: No Deluge source saved locally; only contracts and verified IDs are recorded.
